title: Paleaceous
summary: PALEA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin palea, straw, chaff.] 1. Chaffy; resembling chaff, or consisting of it; as a paleaceous pappus. 2. Chaffy; furnished with chaff; as a paleaceous receptacle.
